title: io.nats.server.monitor.v1.subsz_request
description: Request options for subsz monitoring endpoint

account.description: Filter based on this account name.

limit.description: Limit is the maximum number of subscriptions that should be returned by Subsz().

offset.description: Offset is used for pagination. Subsz() only returns connections starting at this offset from the global results.

subscriptions.description: Subscriptions indicates if subscription details should be included in the results.

test.description: Test the list against this subject. Needs to be literal since it signifies a publish subject. We will only return subscriptions that would match if a message was sent to this subject.
